description.short: Start and follow Open-Inspect coding sessions from Teams.
description.full: Mention the bot in a channel that is bound to an Open-Inspect team to start a coding session on one of the team's repositories. The bot replies in a new thread, keeps the thread updated while the agent works, and posts the result with a link to the pull request and the web session. Mention the bot in the thread to send follow-up prompts; use 'status' and 'stop' inside a thread, and 'help' anywhere.

commands.title: status
commands.description: In a thread: the session's state, repository, model and web link

commands.title: stop
commands.description: In a thread: stop the running turn

commands.title: help
commands.description: Show how to use the bot
